task.title: Enroll a Device in eduroam
task.shortdesc: Enroll your device in eduroam, which is NC State's encrypted wireless network.

taskbody.prereq: Have your Unity ID and password ready, and be sure to use the device you want to connect. Also make sure the device is connected to the internet, but not through the ncsu-guest network.

step.cmd: On your device, go to wifi.ncsu.edu/eduroam and download NC State's configuration tool.
Open the tool and follow its instructions for your device.
step.info: For step-by-step help, see NC State’s eduroam page in Related links.

step.cmd: Connect to eduroam in your device's WiFi settings.
step.info: eduroam also works at other participating universities, so you can connect at conferences without the hassle of asking for guest access.

taskbody.result: Your device now automatically connects on campus and at any participating institutions.
taskbody.postreq: Re-enroll your device every five years. You'll receive an email when it's time.
